texts.label: R966, Salinas, 21 Aug 1676
texts.summary: Salinas to Fuenmayor, London 21 Aug 1676: Charles II tells Salinas that an invasion of France would harm the peace and that the Maastricht and Philippsburg sieges will end the campaign; the King is in a bad humour over German successes; on the passports he favours the Münster precedent against the princes' new claims (Lorraine); no treaty talk until the campaign ends.
